hints.title: Binary Representation Conversion
hints.text: Convert each integer in nums into its binary string representation without leading zeros.

hints.title: Permutation Exhaustion
hints.text: Because the array length is exactly 3, there are only factorial(3) = 6 possible concatenation orders.

hints.title: Base 2 Parsing
hints.text: Evaluate all 6 concatenated binary strings in base 2 and return the maximum integer value.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing all 6 permutations takes constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force over 6 permutations is optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies permutation checking over the fixed 3 elements.
